SELECT id,display_name,ean,category_id,category_name,category_ids,unit_price,price_format,available,published,synced_at,price_per_unit,price_per_unit_unit,ingredients,allergens,nutrition,conservation,preparation,denomination,origin,detail_synced_at,promo_name,promo_text,promo_start,promo_end,strikethrough_price,regions,regional_prices,raw,md5(to_jsonb(p)::text) AS source_row_md5 FROM public.carrefour_products p WHERE (published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)|b[ií]fidus'))
      AND NOT (published IS TRUE AND (display_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)' OR category_name ~* '(agua|aigua|water|yogu|yogh|iogur|patat|papat)'))
      AND id COLLATE "C" > '' COLLATE "C" ORDER BY id COLLATE "C" LIMIT 100
